    Frequently Asked Questions

    Is it safe for all skin types? +

    Yes. It works physically (not chemically), so there's no irritation from harsh ingredients. Safe for sensitive, oily, and dry skin.

    How many uses do I get from one roll? +

    You can get hundreds of applications from a single roll

    Is it hard to cut and apply? +

    No. Cut with scissors, peel, stick. Takes 30 seconds. If you can apply a bandage, you can do this!

    Does it work anywhere on the body? +

    Absolutely. Simply cut larger pieces for back, chest, or any other big area.

    How long should I leave it on? +

    8-10 hours (overnight is ideal). Remove when it turns white/opaque. Reapply if needed.

    What does it contain? +

    The hydrocolloid has tea tree oil and salicylic acid included in its formula.

    What if it doesn't work for me? +


    Love it or your money back!

    Try our hydrocolloid roll for 30 days. If you’re not happy, return it for a full refund.
